# Better Cricket

> Better Cricket is the platform Australian cricket clubs run on. It keeps your club's full match history online and turns it into a beautiful public website — live player profiles, leaderboards, all-time records, partnerships, awards, honour boards, season yearbooks and shareable stat cards — then adds modules for team selection, social posts, club admin and analytics. Connect your club once and the entire history (going back decades in many cases) is imported automatically, and stats keep updating after every match with zero data entry. Better Cricket is made by BetterSports (ABN 32 624 335 397). Built by club cricketers, for club cricketers.

## What Better Cricket Is

Better Cricket (https://betterat.cricket) is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform built specifically for community and club-level cricket organisations in Australia. It solves a long-standing problem: a club's history is scattered across spreadsheets, old PDFs and a handful of disconnected apps, and only the most recent season is ever easy to see. Better Cricket imports a club's full historical dataset — every batter, every bowler, every catch, every partnership, every game — and presents it as a fast, modern, public-facing club website that members, parents, players, sponsors and supporters actually want to visit. On top of that it runs the parts of a club that usually live in separate tools: availability and selection, match-day social graphics, fees and member comms, and opposition analytics.

The platform is used by Australian cricket clubs (initially built for and proven at Applecross Cricket Club in Perth, Western Australia) and is offered to any cricket club that wants automated, beautiful, accurate stats and one place to run the club — without the spreadsheet maintenance overhead. Onboarding is hands-on: the Better Cricket team handles the technical setup, including the first full historical sync.

## Who Better Cricket Is For

- **Australian cricket clubs** of all sizes — premier grade, district, suburban, country, association and association-of-associations clubs
- **Stats volunteers, club historians and committee members** who currently maintain stats in Excel, Google Sheets or by hand
- **Club captains, selectors and coaches** who want fast access to player form, availability, head-to-head matchups, team selection and opposition scouting
- **Treasurers and secretaries** who want fees, membership and member email in one place instead of three
- **Club presidents and committees** who want a professional public web presence that showcases the club's history and achievements
- **Players** who want a permanent online record of their own career stats, milestones and career-best moments — and a shareable stat card for social media
- **Parents and supporters** who want to follow a junior or family member's stats across a season
- **Sponsors** who want visible placement on a site their players use every week

## What Problems Better Cricket Solves

- A club's history is locked in spreadsheets that only show recent stats — Better Cricket imports and presents **decades of historical data** (confirmed back to 1975 for some clubs)
- Manual stats tracking is **slow, error-prone and dies the moment the volunteer steps away** — Better Cricket syncs automatically
- Club records and honour boards are usually buried in club rooms or PDFs — Better Cricket makes them **searchable, shareable and always current**
- Most player profiles are sparse — Better Cricket offers **rich profiles** with career trends, partnership data, dismissal breakdowns, milestone badges, club honours and a shareable stat card
- Season yearbooks are usually a PDF a few people read — Better Cricket produces a **web-based yearbook** with auto-populated honours, results, photos and editorial sections
- The weekly "who's in?" selection scramble lives in **group chats and spreadsheets** — BetterSelect collects availability with no player accounts and suggests a balanced XI from form, grade and role
- Match-day graphics are made by hand in a **design app** — BetterSocials auto-fills cricket-native templates from your own match data
- Fees, membership and member email live in **three different tools** — BetterAdmin runs them off the same member list as your stats
- Opposition prep is guesswork — BetterIQ turns your own scorecards into an opposition dossier and a selection brain

## The Product (Core + Modules)

Better Cricket is sold as **Good / Better / Best** tier bundles. Every club gets the Core; higher tiers unlock more modules.

### BetterStats — the Core (every club)
The foundation: automatic data ingestion, your club's full reconciled history, and the public club website. Player profiles, leaderboards, club records, partnership records, match scorecards, season yearbooks, awards & honours, StatLab custom queries, player comparison and shareable stat cards. There is no manual data entry — the full history is imported on first sync, and stats refresh automatically after every match.

### BetterSelect — availability & smart team selection (Better tier)
Players set their own availability with no account and no app — a magic link plus the last four digits of their phone. Captains and selectors get a whole-squad availability grid, drag-and-drop squad boards, live fixtures and grade ladders, and a form-, grade- and gender-aware autofill that suggests a balanced XI on numbered batting slots.

### BetterSocials — your website + match-day posts (Better tier)
Runs your club's public website and a post designer that turns match data into share-ready graphics — lineups, announcements, toss, player of the match, final score and full scorecards. Scorecards auto-fill from your own match data; everything is in your crest, colours and display fonts; one-tap PNG export.

### BetterAdmin — the back office (Best tier)
Fees, comms and merch in one place, all working off your member list. BetterFees auto-allocates match-fee payments (oldest game first) and keeps a live, always-correct Paid / Part-paid / Unpaid picture, with membership tiers, credit and waivers. BetterComms sends bulk email to your member database with compliant unsubscribes. BetterMerch (stock & sales) is coming soon.

### BetterIQ — opposition scouting & analytics (Best tier)
Reads your own scorecards and turns them into an opposition dossier (danger players, recent form, head-to-head, a printable captain's cheat sheet), a live best-available XI, player trends and deep dives, and broadcast-grade team analysis by innings phase. No extra data entry and no ball-by-ball scoring required.

## Key Features (the Core, in detail)

### Automatic Stats Sync
Once a club is connected, Better Cricket handles all the data work. The full historical dataset is imported on first sync — career batting, bowling, fielding and partnership figures back to the early days of the club where data exists. After that, stats refresh automatically each week (and on-demand via the admin panel) so the website always reflects the latest matches. There is no manual data entry, no CSV upload and no scorer chasing required.

### Player Profiles
Every player gets a public profile page with full career stats, season-by-season breakdown, career progression charts, dismissal-type breakdown, batting-position analysis, partnership history, milestone achievements (500 runs, 50 wickets, 100 games, etc.), club awards and honours, and a player photo. Profiles are publicly linkable, mobile-friendly and include a one-tap-share stat card.

### Leaderboards
Live, filterable leaderboards across every batting, bowling and fielding category — most runs, batting average, high score, fifties, centuries, sixes, fours, ducks, most wickets, bowling average and economy, best figures, five-wicket hauls, maidens, catches (split into outfield and wicket-keeper), run-outs and stumpings. Filter by any season and grade.

### Club Records & Partnerships
All-time and season-best records across batting, bowling, all-rounders, partnerships and team milestones — including the complete partnership history for every wicket position. Records set in the current season are flagged "NEW".

### Season Yearbooks
A publishable digital yearbook for every season, auto-populated with results and honours, then layered with editorial — President's Report, Coach's Report, sponsor messages, photo galleries, custom awards and an honour board.

### Match Scorecards
Full scorecards for every game with batting, bowling, fall of wickets and partnership splits for both innings. Every player name links straight to their profile.

### StatLab — Custom Query Builder
A power-user analytics tool to build any leaderboard with any combination of filters and thresholds across 50+ metrics, plus preset queries.

### Player Comparison & Shareable Cards
Side-by-side career comparison of any two players, and a clean, branded social-share card on every profile with rank badges and milestones.

### Awards & Honours Management
A complete digital record of the club's honours — annual awards, hall of fame, life memberships, association honours, office bearers and premierships — with CSV bulk import for back-filling decades of history.

### Admin Tools & Notification Centre
Duplicate-player detection and one-click merge (preserves all historical stats), display-name overrides, grade renaming, CSV import/export, manual sync with live progress, multiple admin logins, and a notification centre that surfaces sync activity and upcoming player milestones.

## Pricing

Simple, flat-rate pricing per club across three tiers — the same fee whether the club has one team or fifty, juniors and seniors, men's and women's. No per-team, per-grade, per-user or per-player fees.

- **Good** — $449/year or $49/month. The Core (BetterStats): your full history and a public club site to be proud of.
- **Better** — $649/year or $69/month. Adds BetterSelect and BetterSocials.
- **Best** — $999/year or $99/month. Adds BetterAdmin (BetterFees + BetterComms + BetterMerch) and BetterIQ.

Annual billing includes two months free. Setup, onboarding and the first historical sync are handled by the Better Cricket team at no extra cost.

## How It Works (in plain English)

1. The club fills out the request-access form (linked from the homepage).
2. The Better Cricket team connects the club and runs the first full historical sync. For most clubs this brings in many seasons of data automatically — every player, every match, every score.
3. The club's public website goes live at a club-specific URL (e.g. `betterat.cricket/your-club-slug`).
4. Each week, an automated sync brings in the latest matches, updates player stats, refreshes leaderboards and flags new records. Admins can also sync on demand.
5. Stats volunteers use the admin panel for the occasional housekeeping (merge duplicate players, log award winners, write the yearbook editorial). Most clubs need under an hour of admin time per month.

## Data and Privacy

Better Cricket keeps your club's match history online and updates it automatically after every match — no spreadsheets and no manual data entry. The figures match what your club already sees on its official competition results. Better Cricket does not change how your club scores or registers; it adds a presentation, history and analytics layer on top, and clubs can export their data as CSV at any time.

## Geography and Sport

- **Sport:** Cricket (Australian club cricket — all formats: T20, one-day, two-day and longer)
- **Country:** Australia
- **Initial region:** Western Australia (Perth metro), with active interest from clubs nationwide
- **Languages:** English

## Founding Story

Better Cricket was built by a club member at **Applecross Cricket Club** in Perth, Western Australia, who was tired of manually updating spreadsheets after every game and wanted his club's rich 100+ year history of stats and honours to be properly preserved, searchable and publicly accessible. After proving the concept at Applecross, the platform — now made by BetterSports — is offered to any Australian cricket club that wants the same thing.

## Example Public Club Pages

Page types each connected club gets at `betterat.cricket/{club-slug}/...`:

- **Dashboard** (`/{club-slug}`): current season summary, recent results, top performers, featured records.
- **Players** (`/{club-slug}/players`): searchable list of every player in the club's history.
- **Player Profile** (`/players/{player-id}`): individual career stats, charts, milestones, honours and shareable stat card.
- **Leaderboards** (`/{club-slug}/leaderboard`): filterable batting, bowling and fielding leaderboards by season and grade.
- **Records** (`/{club-slug}/records`): all-time club records.
- **Games** (`/{club-slug}/games`) and **Match Scorecard** (`/games/{match-id}`).
- **Yearbook** (`/{club-slug}/yearbook`) and **StatLab** (`/{club-slug}/statlab`).
